QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Public Safety Problems
QuestInfo.0: Icebyrd Slimm asks how you've been holding up. He requested that you visit him in NLC, saying the city could use any help you'd be willing to offer.
QuestInfo.1: You decide to lend NLC a hand as Icebyrd Slimm asked you to. Meet with Lita, NLC's sheriff.
QuestInfo.2: Lita, the sheriff of NLC, seems not to fully trust in your abilities.
